subject: LightHouse Senior Retention Results
body:
Dear Vicky Lim,

Good news! We have an available vacancy for you for the upcoming semester.
At the moment, the available room is most likely a non-air-conditioned room. If you are happy to accept this offer, please let me know by monday, 13 July 2026.
If we do not hear from you by then, we will proceed to offer the vacancy to the next student on the waitlist.
Thank you, and I look forward to your reply.

Kind Regards,

Renatta
